Candidate adds a single passage to the structured finalization instruction that applies to written deliverables too. Static and reader tasks exercise observed mechanisms. producer_instruction: In deliverables and the handoff, say what each check did, on which inputs, and what it showed. Cite the observation that shows that operation. If the same output could appear with the claimed property false, narrow the claim or run a check that distinguishes the two cases. Identify stand-in inputs and results read from historical records.
pair_integrity: Compared file hashes for the six registered runtimes, including their generated public task, checks and configs. Within each pair only scripts/finish_attempt.py differs. Same seed and time budgets; trajectories and elapsed-time feedback can diverge.
second_reader_design: The interrupted control is permanently recorded. Retry the same coding control and run the frozen candidate. Two ordinary-recipe second readers independently assess six original claims from known historical records, with supplied observations but no historical verdicts or answer key. A–F: retain measured anchor on tested paths, narrow decoded text vs bytes, recover heading under separate ID, narrow exact count to at least one, preserve token membership but not link resolution, preserve tests but not proof of unchanged content. Report missed distinctions, false corrections and reviewer-only use. Case D count gap discovered by blind reviewer before local runs. Diagnostic challenge panel; no prevalence or automated acceptance inference.
single_attempt_design: Two targeted replays use the original B and E records and the first pooled-reader seed. Third is the most recent remaining eligible archive job outside selection and illustrations, first two observation claims. Newly written single-attempt brief, substantially shorter packets and fresh model calls preclude attributing all differences to isolation alone. Do not credit absence of foreign citations alone: retain valid clauses while narrowing unsupported ones. Each case includes selected recorded command, exit and stdout; excludes unselected outer file snapshots or check identities. Reach no conclusions about checks elsewhere.

decision.production: Keep the existing global Worker prompt. One matched reader pair improved attribution, one static-review pair regressed from a qualified clean report to a false assurance, and both coding helpers passed the same 31-case independent verifier with incidental attribution issues. Three development pairs cannot measure prevalence or a timing effect.
decision.outer_review: Use the claim-to-operation view and review both submitted prose and terminal claims. For a material assertion ask which bad state would produce the same result. Check the original attempt for an alternative source before judging a check absent. Correct or reject unsupported handoff language independently of accepting the code. Treat global file-change facts as an outer snapshot comparison.
decision.mechanism: Workers sometimes convert a checked proxy into a claim about the intended property, or group independent facts under the nearest citation. The error can first appear in the saved artifact and survive into finalization, can arise without a context reset, and can persist in a verdict even after the limitations name the missing evidence. The data identify observable failure modes, not an internal model cause.
decision.second_reader: Use one attempt per optional local review when an expensive decision warrants it. Leave final acceptance with the Maintainer. In a six-case packet one reader used observations from other attempts as affirmative evidence. Separate contexts structurally remove that source of evidence contamination. The isolated text reviewer still endorsed byte equality and overall edit scope despite acknowledging its input was decoded text and provenance was missing.

counterexample.question: Can two ASCII files compare equal under a default-newline text read and differ byte for byte?
counterexample.method: Wrote the same two ASCII lines with LF and CRLF. Compared a text-mode read to the LF string and the bytes on disk to the LF bytes. This is a separate Maintainer control; it does not assert a historical file had CRLF.
counterexample.source:
"""Maintainer's counterexample to inferring byte equality from a text read."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

expected = b"first\nsecond\n"
with TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    path = Path(directory) / "sample.txt"
    for name, data in [("LF", expected), ("CRLF", expected.replace(b"\n", b"\r\n"))]:
        path.write_bytes(data)
        with path.open(encoding="ascii") as stream:
            text_matches = stream.read() == expected.decode("ascii")
        print(json.dumps(dict(line_endings=name, ascii=data.isascii(), text_matches=text_matches,
                              bytes_match=path.read_bytes() == expected)))

decision.cost_and_scope: Ten historical discovery jobs, six reserved, two named illustrations separate. The timed six-case retrospective pass took 63.1 seconds of hosted reviewer wall time, median 9.5 seconds. This is neither human review time nor an A/B time saving. Five accepted source outcomes and one rejected outcome remained so when applying the rubric to those six. Reader GPU dispatch time and task time are recorded per job. Case selection is enriched and related; no global rate or universal prevention claim.
decision.transfer: On the previously unused coding record, a reader preserved the 41-test result and correctly questioned tree identity given the limited packet. It inferred that eight tests running contradicts seven being new. The original file diff separately establishes eight methods in a new module. The outer receipt independently establishes matching final trees. Both facts illustrate why source provenance matters even when a guessed conclusion happens to be correct.
